title_en: GeoAudit: deterministic geometry auditing of binding pockets across oncology targets and modalities
title_zh: GeoAudit：面向肿瘤靶点与多模态的确定性结合口袋几何审计
scientific_question_en: Can a shared fail-closed Foliation chemistry methodology produce target-specialized, modality-protocoled computational candidates without transferring pocket, binding, or clinical claims across targets or disease programs?
truth_boundary_en: Paper-facing scope and Appendix A pilot only. Candidate evidence lives in the companion repository. CHEMISTRY_READY and pocket DCA are not clinical, IND, novelty, or efficacy claims.
